SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT E_MTOCD FROM PRD001 WHERE MTOCD = ':1'

SELECT DISTINCT BOMAP11.PT_NO, A.MODELCODE, A.EF, BOMAP11.B_PT_NO,BOMAP11.DC_EF_DT,BOMAP11.DC_ED_DT FROM BOMAP11, (SELECT PRD001.PAT_MTO AS BOMCODE, PRD001.MTOCD AS MODELCODE, PRD001.EFM AS EF FROM PRD001 WHERE (PRD001.MTOCD = ':1' OR PRD001.MTOCD = ':2' ) ) A WHERE substr(BOMAP11.APL_MT, 0, length(A.BOMCODE)) = A.BOMCODE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN BOMAP11.DC_EF_DT AND BOMAP11.DC_ED_DT and BOMAP11.PT_NO like :3 ORDER BY BOMAP11.PT_NO
